title: Casino Video Security Analytics Event
description: Schema for video analytics events generated by casino security camera systems including object detection, zone crossing, anomaly detection, and crowd density analysis

event_id.description: Unique UUID for this video analytics event

camera_location.description: Casino zone where the camera is located, e.g. slot_floor_a, cage_area, entrance_main

event_type.description: Classification of the video analytics event

timestamp.description: UTC date-time when the event was detected

confidence_score.description: Model confidence score for the detection

object_count.description: Number of objects detected in the event frame or zone

bounding_box.description: Bounding box coordinates for the primary detected object in the frame

x.description: X coordinate of the top-left corner

y.description: Y coordinate of the top-left corner

track_id.description: Tracking identifier for multi-frame object tracking across consecutive frames

zone_from.description: Casino zone the tracked object moved from during a zone crossing event

zone_to.description: Casino zone the tracked object moved to during a zone crossing event

dwell_time_seconds.description: Duration in seconds the object remained in the detected zone

anomaly_type.description: Specific anomaly classification when event_type is anomaly

alert_level.description: Severity level of the security alert

frame_number.description: Frame number within the video stream where the event was detected

video_resolution.description: Resolution of the camera video feed

fps.description: Frames per second of the camera video feed

model_name.description: Name of the AI model that generated the detection, e.g. YOLOv8, DeepSORT

model_version.description: Version identifier of the AI model used for detection

metadata.description: Additional key-value pairs for extended event context

load_time.description: Timestamp when the record was loaded into the pipeline
